args.new_string:
## Geometry readback and import limits

Fresh native readback shows the Edge_Cuts Gerber path is a closed rectangle from X=100 to 140 mm and Y=-100 to -130 mm, with a 0.100 mm plotting aperture. Its 40 x 30 mm centerline rectangle has 40.1 x 30.1 mm plotted stroke bounds, consistent with the job-file Size metadata. The <=40 x 30 mm requirement remains the intended finished outline; do not mistake the stroke bounds for an authorized larger board. Fabricator/CAM interpretation and finished-edge tolerance still require review. The DXF coordinates are inch-scaled: its outer four lines convert by 25.4 to the same 40 x 30 mm rectangle, and the file also contains hole circles and slot outlines. Confirm units and desired entities when importing; no visual import or physical-fit qualification is claimed.

The generated job metadata also states two copper layers, board thickness 1.6 mm, nominal 0.035 mm F.Cu/B.Cu and FR4 dielectric. These are source/export metadata, not confirmed fabrication material or process tolerances. The Gerber/drill/job generation timestamp 2026-10-09 08:45:32+09:00 corresponds to 2026-10-08 23:45:32 UTC.

Rationale: reading actual geometry reconciles the plotted-size metadata without modifying the board, relaxing the envelope or equating data generation with a manufactured result.
